title: [suggestion] Implement a sort of "command buffer" for omnipod Eros pumps in the app
symptom: When a bolus is being administered, other interactions with the pump are disabled, so a new basal suggestion cannot be applied until the bolus finishes. In open loop mode, a new basal suggestion may arrive while a bolus is still in progress, and the user cannot apply it.
cause: The thread explains that this is likely a hard-coded limitation in the pump firmware, and that during a bolus you cannot issue another command to the pump anyway.
fix: The maintainer explains that a command queue already exists for background commands, and that showing a bolus progress dialog is intentional to let the user verify bolus delivery. No code change was made; the issue was closed as not a bug.
evidence_quote: This already exists. It's called `CommandQueue` and it does work for background commands (setting of profile, TBR, SMB etc). Having a dialog for bolus progress is our decision because most pumps support displaying progress and during bolus you cannot issue another command to the pump anyway.
